function.name: get_province_id

province_name.description: The name of the province for which the ID is requested. For example: 'Bangkok', 'Chiang Mai', 'Chonburi'.

country_code.description: The ISO country code to ensure the province is identified within the correct country context. For example: 'TH' for Thailand.
